issues: The On Evolve damage effect is missing the required target selection. Encode it so it selects an enemy follower on the field, then deals 4 damage to that selected follower and 4 damage to its leader.

The Fanfare condition is encoded incorrectly as fieldTraitMin with trait "Evolved". It should check whether there is an evolved follower on your field; add an implemented condition for allied evolved follower count/presence and use that condition before buffing this follower +1/+1.

The passive trigger should apply only when another follower with "Ghost" in its name enters your field. Add exclusion of this card itself to the grantOnAllyFollowerEnter filter/trigger so it matches "another follower".

The cemetery activated ability checks the wrong zone. It should check whether there is a Masquerade Ghost in your EX area, not on your field; add an implemented condition for named card presence in EX area and use that condition.
The cemetery activated ability is missing the optional choice. It should be optional to summon a Sincere Masquerade Ghost from your evolve deck; encode the summon as optional.

The spell ability should search your deck for a Masquerade Ghost and summon it, but the current tutorFromDeck to field may not represent summon wording accurately. If summon-from-deck semantics differ in your engine, add a dedicated deck search/summon implementation or confirm tutorFromDeck to field is treated as summon.

The Fanfare condition is encoded incorrectly as fieldTraitMin with trait "Amulet". It should check whether there is an amulet on your field; add an implemented condition for allied amulet count/presence and use that before healing your leader 2.

The trigger timing is too broad. It should trigger once per turn when an amulet you control leaves the field, not whenever this card leaves the field; add an implemented trigger for allied amulet leaves-field events and use that with oncePerTurn true.

The passive ability is encoded with onDamaged, but the source text triggers whenever this follower gains attack or defense. Replace it with a trigger for stat gain that grants this follower Storm; add an implemented timing/effect hook for when a follower is buffed or its stats increase.

The choice structure is incorrect. By default this spell should choose exactly 1 option, and only if there are at least 5 Chess cards in your cemetery should you choose up to 2 instead; encode this with a conditional switching between choose(max 1) and chooseMultiple(max 2), and add a cemetery trait-count condition for Chess cards if not implemented.
